title: Music and rhythm
examples: Teacher, can we clap a song rhythm?
What is the beat in music?
How do we make music sound loud?

explain.say: Listen to the steady beat in the music.
The beat is the steady, regular pulse of the music.
We can make music sound loud or soft.
Let us try clapping a simple pattern now.
When we clap, we follow the beat and the pattern.
When you walk to the playground, you keep a steady beat.

faq.q: What is the difference between beat and rhythm?
faq.a: The beat is the steady, constant pulse you feel. Rhythm is the pattern of long and short sounds you make on top of the beat.
asks: Is beat the same as tempo?
What is the beat in music?

faq.q: How do I make music sound quiet?
faq.a: You make it sound quiet by whispering or using gentle sounds. This is called soft dynamics.
asks: Can I make music very quiet?

faq.q: Can clapping help me learn rhythm?
faq.a: Yes, clapping is a great way to practice rhythm. You can clap patterns that match the beat.
asks: How do I practice rhythm with my hands?

faq.a: The beat is the steady, regular pulse you tap your foot to. It keeps the music moving forward.
asks: What is the steady pulse in music?

faq.q: How do I know when to be loud or quiet?
faq.a: You listen carefully to the music to see if it gets big or small. Loud means big sound, and quiet means small sound.
asks: What are loud and quiet sounds called?
How do I play soft music?

faq.a: A clapping pattern is a specific order of claps. You follow the beat while making a set pattern of claps.

facts: The beat is the underlying, steady pulse in music.
Music can be played loudly or quietly.
Clapping patterns help us practice rhythm.
A steady pulse can be felt when walking.

quiz.say: If the music is very soft, what are you doing?
quiz.why: Whispering is a quiet way to make sound, like soft music.

wrong.0: Running is movement, not making a quiet sound.
wrong.2: Shouting is too loud; we are looking for quiet.
wrong.3: Clapping hard makes a big sound, not a quiet one.

quiz.say: What is the steady pulse in music called?
quiz.why: The beat is the constant, steady pulse you feel in the music.

wrong.0: Rhythm is the pattern of sounds, not the steady pulse itself.
wrong.1: A pattern is what you clap, but the beat is the steady time underneath it.
wrong.2: Sound is what we hear, but the beat is the steady timing of that sound.

quiz.say: If you clap: clap, clap, pause, what are you doing?
quiz.why: You are making a specific, repeated pattern of claps.

wrong.1: Keeping the beat means keeping it steady, but this has a pause.
wrong.2: Making a sound is too general; this is a specific clapping sequence.
wrong.3: This action does not tell us if the sound is loud or quiet.
